property.android:value: Background retention and management of WebView. This service is used to manage JS elements of the page during the background life of the WebView, as well as during the life of the application in the foreground. While in the background, it also ensures the persistence of the WebView session and prevents the automatic reclamation of resources allocated to the browser engine processes. This is necessary so that the application does not lose the state of the loaded page and active connections when moving to the background. I do not use the mediaPlayback type, as it in background mode can forcibly translate system AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS events into the state of AudioContext and HTMLMediaElement, allowing third-party sites through Web Audio API tracking the fact of user switching to other audio applications, which can lead to leakage of data about background activity and violate user confidentiality, as well as harm the work of application functionality sending excessive signals about the page visibility state, which contradict the application logic, which occurs on certain browser engines. As most of these events occur at the browser engine level, attempts to fix this through JS do not always help and using the SpecialUse type is the only correct solution. Also, I do not use the DataSync type because it has a limit of 6 hours, however a user can actively use my application and accordingly the WebView management service more than 6 hours.
